english: I'm fairly confident we'll prevail.
I'm feeling better already.
I'm feeling quite satisfied. My expedition was a success! I've collected enough of Oola's ancient equipment to keep me tinkering happily for years—not to mention making me a small fortune.
I'm fresh out of shinies.
I'm glad I earned your trust, and I'm proud to be your ally.
I'm glad I was here to support my uncle.
I'm glad she was there for you.
I'm glad they sent a Lionguard to escort us. I mean, I'm no fighter. We're just trying to make a living, and traveling so close to that lake bothers me.
I'm glad to be part of Dragon's Watch, and I appreciate you looking out for me, but I won't be told what I can or can't do.
I'm glad to have survived, but it hurts to lose such a close friend. Even with this little one by my side, I still miss her. Thank you for going with me. It helped more than you can know.
I'm glad to make your acquaintance. Farewell.
I'm glad we've driven off Mordremoth's influence for now, but this victory is temporary. Maybe if you touch the crystal?
I'm glad you're feeling better. Good-bye.
I'm going as fast as I can. The Mordrem are back, sniffing around this whole area.
I'm going to ace my next exam!
I'm going to get the survivors to Hoelbrak. Make sure they get shelter and food, let Whitebear know that we didn't need his help. Then, I'll start looking for the Alliance base. Save the prisoners.
I'm going to go.
I'm going to have fun playing with you.
I'm going to have to stop you there, Commander. Aurene needs her rest.
I'm going to make you sorry.
I'm going to mingle. See you around.
I'm going to see Taimi soon, and I plan to tell her everything that happened.
I'm going to sleep well tonight.
I'm going to tell him you said that.
I'm going to tell you guys a little secret. When talking to hylek, never ever ever—
I'm gonna keep running until I'm as fast as you!
I'm headed out to an old temple on the coast. Been hearing rumors of spirits out that way.
I'm here on a diplomatic mission, for Her Majesty. I must confess that I've been feeling rather like a bit of gold among lumps of coal, though. These norn live so roughly.
I'm here to hunt, not to flirt.
I'm here to put a few centaurs out of their misery.
I'm here to take the bandits down a few notches.
I'm honestly not sure.
I'm impressed that you would still fight at our side, after how we treated you.
I'm impressed. Thanks.
I'm in charge here, human. What do you want?
I'm in charge of guarding the supplies. Take it to Vethrax, near the Well of Anguish—but be careful, it's volatile!
I'm in need of scrap metal from the canyons ahead so I can build a devourer attractor to rescue the captain from her fiery prison.
I'm in pretty bad shape...
I'm in the midst of conducting very important research. The cattlepult is on the verge of a breakthrough.
I'm in your bag! I put a two-way communicator in there when you were in Rata Novus.
I'm in. What should I do?
I'm innocent. I swear it!
I'm just browsing, thanks.
I'm just not cut out for jungle life.
I'm listed with the Durmand Priory as an expert in ancient magics, including lost Flame Legion arts.
I'm looking for recruits. If you're brave enough, report to me.
I'm loyal to the Pact. I always will be.
I'm no stranger to curiosity, little one.
I'm not "hacking," for the love of— Commander, if you want those files, then they're waiting at the MinSec office.
I'm not afraid of a book.
I'm not afraid of those beasts or those ice-heads.
I'm not amused.
I'm not at liberty to... Ah. Yes. A ritual greeting. Fine, thank you.
I'm not dead.
I'm not done yet.
I'm not dying in this accursed jungle, and neither are you.
I'm not going back into that yard. I've had enough work for today.
I'm not going to pass on that offer.
I'm not going to poke the Exalted for you, Taimi.
I'm not good with people.
I'm not hunting for treasure. I'm searching for answers.
I'm not just a snot-snouted farhar cub anymore. I stowed away to join the Anvil warband, remember?
I'm not leading you by the hand to your death. That's a noose you'll have to tie on your own.
I'm not looking for ale right now.
I'm not looking for treasure. I'm looking for—well, something else.
I'm not playing around!
I'm not pleased anyone has to get attacked by centaurs. But if it has to be someone, they've got better defenses and are closer to Divinity's Reach to get resupplied.
I'm not ready to die yet!
I'm not ready to do this.
I'm not really much of an architecture fan. Good-bye.
I'm not really sure. I just follow orders. You should ask the professor.
I'm not so sure about this...but those goods do look pretty exotic.
I'm not sticking around to see where this goes.
I'm not sure I can keep up with you two, but have fun.
I'm not sure I need anyone, actually.
I'm not sure of the curriculum, but history classes must be part of it.
I'm not sure which of your krewe members are currently within, though knowing your krewe's reputation for dedication to your work, probably all of them.
I'm not sure, that's why I asked!
I'm not sure. It was nice and crispy though.
I'm not sure. They're pressing with every available airship, and I hear that the Pact has been working on a special weapon that packs a wallop.
I'm not surprised to see you're involved here, Hobbs; good to see you.
I'm not talking about eating. I'm talking about angry little mushrooms!
I'm not telling you anything. Beat me, brand me, threaten my life and livelihood—
I'm not too far from the basin, Rytlock. I'll meet you there.
I'm not too worried about choya. Nothing's going to get between me and buried treasure.
I'm not worried, I have the lich lord's luck on my side.
I'm not worried. At a progeny's level, it's nothing more than a simple transformation. It wouldn't be too difficult to break it.
I'm not? It's just I haven't seen your lot around here before, thought I'd say hello.
I'm occupied with trying to keep us alive. Either help or get out of the way.
I'm okay for now, thanks.
I'm old, and this lake has grown too dangerous! Skale, drakes, and Grenth knows what else lurking under the waters.
I'm on your tail.
I'm out! Now for the others! Have we destroyed all the control nodes? If not, get on it! We leave no krewe member behind.
I'm outmatched!
I'm outta here!
I'm overwhelmed. I feel like I could reach out and take hold of my destiny.
I'm pretty sure the master-at-arms, the chief engineer, and the doc survived the crash. Still, none of them have made it back.
I'm pretty sure you could do this yourself. The hylek can't be that much of a threat.
I'm ready to be done with traveling for good.
I'm ready to fight now.
I'm ready to go now.
I'm ready too.
I'm ready. Disguise me.
I'm really more of a dog person.
I'm requisitioning assistance. Help, please!
I'm right beside you.
I'm ruined! The grawl stole my supplies. What's gotten into them recently? They used to stay on their own side of the lake.
I'm scouting here. Big talls all over. Scared to move. Must get home. Must save digs and find shinies! I like shinies.
I'm shielded!
I'm sick of these cowardly mice. We would crush 'em flat if they came out of their little holes.
I'm so curious. What was Mordremoth like?
I'm so glad to be free. I'm sure the krait would have happily worked me to death.
I'm so hungry... Do you have any food?
I'm so pleased to be able to work on my archaeology. You bring me the best stuff!
I'm so smart.
I'm so sorry for everything that was said and done to the sylvari.
I'm so sorry to hear that.
I'm so sorry; I'm trying to keep track of too many things at the moment. Come back later? Actually, later might not be any better.
I'm so tired of digging, but these chests are worth it. Well, not that I've done any of the actual digging.
I'm so tired, I think I'm already dreaming.
I'm sorry you lost that opportunity. Must be hard.
I'm sorry, Canach. However I can help to catch him...
I'm sorry, Canach. However, I can help to catch him...
I'm sorry, Commander, but I'm going to have to ask you to master gliding before I take you up. We don't have enough copters to bring you back down again...
I'm sorry, I can't stay. I must power the pylon for Westwatch.
I'm sorry, I don't have time to help you right now.
I'm sorry, I have no time to help you.
I'm sorry, but I don't do small talk.
I'm sorry, but—you're a dwarf. Or what's left of one.
I'm sorry, it didn't feel right to leave you in ignorance. Old court habits die hard, I guess.
I'm sorry, that's incorrect.
I'm sorry. I so admire the things you've done. Throughout the city, women like me wish they could be more like you. I need a moment to regain my composure.
I'm sorry. Thank you for telling me your story.
I'm starting to get angry now!
I'm starving. You got any grub on you?
I'm still missing some pieces. How did you find us?
I'm still not certain what just happened, but those...things...should just stay in their realm.
I'm studying under Snargle to improve my craft. I think my writing's actually gotten worse.
I'm sure I have no idea why we're doing this. Ask Krattz. This is part of his paranoid delusion.
I'm sure he'll turn up.
I'm sure it is. Take care.
I'm sure it would have, and I'm sorry you were dragged into the situation. You fought well, though, and you deserve all the praise in the world. Thank you, friend.
I'm sure my skimmer could use a lap or two.
I'm sure the engineers appreciated your help.
I'm sure. Keep an eye out anyway.
I'm surprised it didn't set off security alarms.
I'm surprised to find someone from House Rolic awake already.
I'm taking a survey. What do you like better? Meat or cheese?
I'm taking these trained devourers to our troops stationed along the Brand. I know I'm gonna run into Flame Legion along the way. I could use the extra firepower if you want to tag along.
I'm telling you, they've built something dangerous in that cave.
I'm telling you, this shark could swallow a norn with one bite! And, it's eating everything in Ocean's Gullet. You have to stop it.
I'm the Crush legionnaire. You got a problem, you take it up with me.
I'm the one and only town guard for Garenhoff. If you run into any trouble, let the elementals handle it.
I'm the stable master here. Mist warriors come and go as they please, but not me. Blood Legion loves this place. Endless warfare, endless glory. And now we've got these warclaws! Times are good.
I'm the top mind in my field, you know.
I'm tired of waiting. But, I'm going to kill a centaur for every minute that I waste sitting here. Try to stay out of my way when it all goes down.
I'm too young and brilliant to die!
I'm trained to protect the nobility, not fight in the jungle.
I'm truly impressed, gatherer. You've done us a service.
I'm truly sorry. I hope you find peace someday.
I'm tuning the Heart of the Obscure to scan for signs of possession.
I'm up here alone for a reason!
I'm very sorry to hear that.
I'm warning you.
I'm with you, Marshal. It's time to end this.
I'm worried. All this tension in the air...something terrible is going to happen. Stay close.
I'm writing a book report on King Joko, and I need help coming up with a closing sentence. What do you think would work best?
I'm...free? I'm free! Thank you, friend—thank you. Another minute stuck in that loop and... (groan)
I've also been collecting trade contracts. That should open a few doors.
I've been afraid. I think I've lived a good life, but I could have done more.

I've been monitoring the skritt from inside their dwelling. Until I needed to leave, they had no idea I was there. I collected valuable data, and I even managed to secure a few of their own belongings.

I've been tracking your legend, %str1%. Don't look so surprised, and don't expect me to tell you how long I've been following your progress. All you need to know is that I was there when you emerged from your College's academy. You've come a long way.
I've been trapped here, tormented by my own demons—paralyzed by the shame of selling out my people.
I've developed new tactics for the junundu trials.
I've devoted my life to the gods, but I've never known them like people did in ages past. And I probably never will.
I've earned the respect of my comrades and forged alliances I can call on in times of need.
I've failed you yet again. This time, I'll leave no part of myself here.
I've felt so lost...but if you know the way...
I've fought my share of centaurs already.
I've fought the grawl and Dragon's corruption for you.
I've got a feeling we're in trouble when night falls.
I've got a job to do, and I'm being followed.
I've got chores to do.
I've got evil in my genius! This cannot continue. The Inquest must go!
I've got it under control. I think. Not sticking around to find out.
I've got just enough intel to start writing, so I appreciate the help. I'd start with Xiaobo. He descended from Minster Jaisan. Not the most...friendly guy in New Kaineng.
I've got nothing better.
I've got other things to do. Bye.
I've got some elemental cores for you.
I've got this. I expect my instincts to take over.
I've got to get this egg somewhere safe!
I've got to help out a friend, so I might be a little late, but...of course. Wouldn't miss it.
I've got work to do. And unless you're here to see the sights, so do you.
I've got you covered!
I've had better ale, but I'm enjoying this well enough.
I've had to do a lot of research to figure out your latest find. Tremendous!
I've heard Eir left her mate and kid behind to adventure.
I've heard it, too. Your people are angry. Scared, maybe.
I've heard she knows a great deal about the Riverlands...and that she might be able to answer some questions for me.
I've heard the Branded and Forged have been squabbling at the Kodash Bazaar.
I've heard the scouts spotted other fires to the west.
I've heard you attract trouble wherever you go. We've got enough of that here without you heating things up. It takes all our energy to repel the waves of undead.
I've hit a bit of a snag. I can't decide whether to use a binary or tridecimal logic structure.
I've just finished delivering disguises to Alarin. A complete and total, utter and unmitigaged success. As are all my successes. Lucky for you, I have a few extra spy kits if you want to buy one.
I've just finished the latest batch of our new, lighter brew: Monastery Light. I think it's going to be a big hit. Would you care to try some?
I've known Cane for many years, and I've never seen him quite so single-minded. Centaurs make his blood boil, and being out here has got him all fired up.
I've never been to Lion's Arch. What's it like there?
I've never had the chance to come aboard one of these airships before. It's breathtaking! How can something so huge float in the air like this?
I've never seen anything like this place.
I've never seen one of those dragon spawn up close before.
I've never seen so much... Oh, I can't even say it!
I've never thought of that.
I've never worn these boots. My feet are actually quite sore.
I've no time for idle patter. Say what you will, and leave me be.
I've only heard Isgarren's voice once before, when I was very little...
I've outdone myself with this year's ales. Tap a keg and try! Please don't share with our little skritt friends, though.
I've performed more calculations on the bloodstone.
I've seen better performances out of the menagerie.
I've seen many worldly wonders. I used to be a scholar at the Durmand Priory, but I left to start up this inn and settle down.
I've seen my share. I expect you will, too.
I've seen pictures of skritt before. Aren't they your mortal enemies or something?
I've seen the new watchknights, yes. They're impressive.
I've seen your proof, but the High Priestess is not here. She's gone to prepare for the procession.
I've spent a long time on this problem, and this is our best option. Part of leading is accepting the cost of that choice.

I've spent a long time on this problem, and this is our best option. Part of leading is accepting the cost of that choice. The truth is, as high as the price is to learn what we've learned, I've never regretted it.
I've still got some time on my previous rental fee.
I've stuck around to warn any wayward travelers about the dangers up ahead. So consider yourself warned.
I've survived the depths of the wilderness. The frost almost killed me, but I've returned.
I've tolerated these nonsense novels in the past, but this is going too far! Any more copies of these books found in Blood Legion territory will be considered contraband.
I've watched enough drifting snow to last me a lifetime.
I've worked here for so long I can't remember anything else. Same every day, researching the Mists. Same table, same trees, same delusional golems that think they need breaks to use the litter box...

I, Bartholos, in 1088 A.E., offer this volume to future generations of Shining Blade, with hope that it will inspire and inform them, thereby increasing their commitment to the Shining Blade's values.
I, I believe—
I, uh...sorry.
I-it was totally just a joke. I love saltspray dragons!
I. Before History (sonnet)
I. Over ten thousand years ago, elder races put aside their differences and forged an alliance against the awakening Elder Dragons. If we'd worked together as planned, we wouldn't have had to hide.
I...I can't remember much of anything. I know that I keep this place safe. I've been alone for a long time. Beyond that...nothing. Can you help me?
I...I don't want to hurt you, Zojja!
I...I suppose you're right. I'm not exactly proud of what I did.
I...do not desire to know the details. Here, these are for the general. Be on your way.
I...have this deep-seated fear of them. To get over my fear, I want to live with them, learn what makes them tick. It may not make much sense, but I feel like understanding them might help.
I...kind of...sort of...no.

If I calculate the exact curves in their lettering...
If I come back from the dead, please use one of Pixtor's weapons here to make sure I stay down. Thanks.
If I fail, these islands will be destroyed. How can I get past the defenses?
If I had access to my workshop, I could take these varmints out in no time. Boom!
If I had men to send I would. I lost too many in an earlier assault. If I rushed with what I have left, this town would be wide open. An adventurer like you could end this siege. Please, help us.
If I wanted excuses, I'd ask you for them. Now, get this golem working!
If I were a troll, I'd hide my runestones somewhere around here. If you find one, grab it and run!
If I were to categorize these major disasters from least catastrophic to most catastrophic, I would order them as such: the Searing of Ascalon, the Jade Wind of Cantha, and the Cataclysm of Orr.
If I'm going to go in and clear out a chak nest, I could sure use some backup.
If I'm reading these writings correctly, Jalis Ironhammer once held out here for two months while the Stone Summit attempted to lay siege to the fort.
If I'm right, the magic in the sediment will seep into the automaton and revive it.
If Jormag corrupts them like Ox and the others—
If Jormag had not eliminated her, Owl would show you many favors. In Owl's absence, you have my gratitude—for what it's worth.
If Kaineng can't be saved, Cantha is doomed.
If King Joko didn't care about us getting the answers right, I'd be done already, too.
If a Kryptis is detected, the host's emotions will be neutralized, starving the demon and drawing them out.
If any among you can be turned, then all of you must be destroyed.
If any nearby Astral Ward members are handy with a skimmer, I could use your help gathering food around here!
If charr were civilized, they'd be human.
If he can reach it in one piece, Deadrun will use an ancient ritual that Ambrose taught him to purify the Orrian temple.
If it helps, I've been there. You have nothing to worry about.
If it's true, he might be a little stronger than we all remember.
If no one objects, I think we should continue our journey.
If not the market, the menagerie would certainly pay for the meat.
If not, then I gotta get Pursing Winds involved, and...(sighs) I just want to get back to cooking. What do you say?
If one of us turns foul, we'll deal with it.
If only I could find a way to charge rodents for all of my crops they eat. I'd be rich.
If only I could see my family again.
If only I had the words then. But when the thing was before us, I could only scream.
If only the Risen could give us some breathing room, we might unearth something to help the Pact effort here.
If only there were a way to reflect its attack back at it.
If only we could get the enchanted armor to talk to us. I've tried, but there was no response.
If other races do not heed our warnings and unite, Jormag will rain destruction upon their unprepared armies. And, it will be our fault for leading him here.
If that circuit can't be completed, the door will never open.
If that circuit can't be completed, they'll never open.
If that's what I think it is...
If the Mordant Crescent seize those graves, they'll create more awakened!
If the Pact isn't in control of the Cannonade, we'll never launch our northern assault of Orr.
If the fox pokes his head into one too many burrows, who knows what will snap at his face...
If they mounted a serious attack, I'm not sure we'd survive.
If they remain in Tyria, they are elusive at best, and many believe they have gone back to the Mists from which they came—perhaps never to return.
If they're in good enough shape to stand watch...but fine. Here's some medicine. That should make them quit their bellyaching.
If they've really worked out all the bugs in these things, how long will it be until they replace the Seraph entirely?
If this keeps up, I may have to revise my calculations.
If this works, we'll have enough pheromones from the female corpses to lure out the Ghost Eater.
If we become the monsters, we've already lost.
If we break those gyros, that should break his shield as well!
If we can find the Preceptors, they'll be able to make a plan. I  just know it!
If we can mend the flow of ley magic, perhaps we can breathe new life into the quarry. Understand its purpose.
If we eliminate every trace of the Inquest's presence here, the Council can't even do that.
If we get out of here, I'm going to burn every one of those plants!

If we let Jabari rob us of our spirit, we'd truly be lost. Kormir promises us that truth is eternal and incorruptible. We've been oppressed by their lies and deception, but her truth will set us free.
If we still have any pilots, we'll evac you before sundown.
If we'd lost any more of these materials, the Necro Draco Destable-a-tron would have barely been able to function.
If we're ever going to hold the outlying sectors for more than a day, we'll need help.
If we're going to survive against the dragons, we have to find answers from the past to help us.
If we're gonna hold this base, you'd better put your backs into it!
If we're unsuccessful, things will get bad. If they put that energy toward attacking, we'll have to retreat.
If ya ever need to just talk things out, swing by. Every few days, 'round dusk. Usually a bite to be had. Pineapple juice.
If you are too few, you must become many. Gather as many of the chosen as you need to empty those mines.
If you can help us out around the camp, we can help you stop the Inquest from succeeding at whatever they're planning.
If you can keep them off me, I can set this up in a minute.
If you care more about people than profit, this isn't the life for you.
If you come in waving the imperial seal around, pretty sure I'd be obligated to give you my incisors if you asked for them.
If you don't know where to go, I'd follow the flowers; they always take the path of least resistance. There are also smaller, broken nests up there I can take you back to if you fall down.
If you don't own a jackal, why not rent one? Rentals are good for an hour, and we provide a whistle to call it back if you dismount.
If you don't own a raptor, why not rent one? Rentals are good for an hour, and come with a whistle to call it back if you dismount.
If you don't own a skiff, why not rent one? Rentals are good for an hour, although you'll need to come back to me to retrieve your skiff if you disembark.
If you don't own a skimmer, why not rent one? Rentals are good for an hour, and we provide a whistle to call it back if you dismount.
If you don't own a springer, why not rent one? Rentals are good for an hour, and we provide a whistle to call it back if you dismount.
If you feel you can benefit from any of my knowledge, you're welcome to it.
If you find any of their kidnap victims there, help them! They shouldn't be left to whatever monsterous fate the Inquest has in mind for them.
If you follow our full journey from Augury to the Throne of Pellentia, as the Chosen once did, you may have an audience with Turai himself.
If you hadn't been here, I don't think we would have made it.
If you have any information, please contact your nearest MinSec officer. And as always, stay sharp.
If you have any last words, speak them now.
If you have business here, get to it; otherwise, stop distracting me.
If you keep pushing, they will shove you out. They're gaining strength by the minute.
If you like crystals, why aren't you studying Aurene's chamber?
If you made it this far into the frontier, then you must be made of toughness. Are you here to help?
If you need a raptor, go ahead and talk to Strigidae. She'll set you up with one.
If you ready, skritt ready.
If you see any fresh crawdads around the beach, let me know! I'm collecting them for a big stew for the Seraph troops who are helping us out.
If you see any skritt, stomp 'em.
If you think I can fight, wait till you see me dance.
If you truly loved your homeland, you'd understand.
If you want me gone, I'll leave right now.
If you want some of the action, you better hurry. There's a combined force—humans and us—going to smack the ogres.
If you want to look inside a dragon's stomach, be my guest.
If you want, we could find some fungus to liven that up for you.
If you wish to beg for your lives, you may do so now.
If you wish to challenge us, first seek out the eight high elder djinn in the Domain of Vabbi. Challenge and defeat them. Only then will you be ready.
If you wish to unburden your souls before you pass, now is the time.
If you're drinkin', I'm brewin'.
If you're headed into the wilderness, take care. I've seen some troubling things lately. May Wolf watch over you.
If you're here to help, welcome. If not, get out of my way.
If you're here, you may as well help me out with gathering.
If you're looking for things to do, I could use some help tending to the garden.
If you're lost, I may be able to help.
If you're ready, let's go fool us some Separatists, hm? I can hit you with the disguise whenever you're ready. Say the word.
If you're seeing double, hit 'em both!
If you're trying to trick us, you'll have to do a better job making up stories than this!
If you're up to the challenge, pick up any jar lying around estate and use it to catch a wasp. After that, offer the wasp to the cows until you find one that wants to eat it.
If you're up to the challenge, pick up any jar lying around estate and use it to catch cave grubs. After that, offer the grubs to the cows until you find one that wants to eat them.
If you're up to the challenge, pick up any jar lying around estate and use it to catch flies. After that, offer the flies to the cows until you find one that wants to eat them.
